Chapter 1 - The servant who sweeps

Next chapter

A new day begins, and Kai Yang woke up. He cleaned up and took the broom lying in the corner of the small room and walked out. Standing at the front door, he stretched a little.

Dressed in black clothes that were simple and clean, the aged clothing colour highlighted the youth's loneliness and years of isolation here. Kai Yang's spine was as straight as a javelin.

Helplessly, Kai Yang could only continue to sweep out here in the outer court. Working hard to support himself and working hard in training.
